sampling.rule: per (map, grid): rng = numpy.random.default_rng(20261009); indices = sorted(rng.choice(grid_size, size=min(64, grid_size), replace=False)); same seed reused for every grid by design

tolerances.continuous_grids: exact on 6-decimal rounded values when the NEW artifact is unquantized (legacy float32); <= scale/2 per cell when the NEW sidecar carries a quantization entry
tolerances.flow_arrival_seconds: <= max(2% of baseline, 1.0 s) per sampled cell
tolerances.flow_unreachable_count: exact per grid (count of 255 sentinel cells)
tolerances.obstruction_normalized_hash: exact (records normalized to 0.1 m before hashing)
